channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Reconhecemos a necessidade de tarifa menor para agricultura familiar, diz Caiado
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado argued that the State should incentivize productive sectors through targeted benefits, emphasizing the need for lower tariffs for family farming.

item.title: Caiado propõe campanha nacional para recuperar 'cultura vacinal' e afastar 'teses malucas'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate and former governor of Goiás, proposed a national campaign to restore Brazil's 'vaccine culture' and counter what he called 'crazy theories' about vaccines. He advocated for Brazil to return as a global reference in vaccination coverage, citing his medical background as the foundation for his health policy proposals presented at the PSD headquarters in São Paulo.

item.title: Mauro e Janaína Riva empatam na disputa pelo Senado em Mato Grosso
item.description: Mauro Mendes (União Brasil) and Janaina Riva (MDB) are technically tied in the race for the two Senate seats in Mato Grosso, with 20% and 18.9% of voting intentions, respectively, according to a Percent Brazil poll released on August 17, 2026. The 2.83 percentage point margin of error renders the difference statistically insignificant. The survey interviewed 1,200 people between August 7–10, is registered with the TSE under MT-03154/2026, and was funded by DOC Comunicação.

item.title: Candidaturas LGBT+ crescem 57% nas eleições de 2026 em comparação com 2022
item.description: LGBT+ candidacies in Brazil's 2026 elections increased by 57% compared to 2022, rising from 220 to 514 candidates. Growth was especially strong in federal deputy races (up 84%, from 116 to 214) and in the North (+141%), Central-West (+88%), and Northeast (+82%) regions. Although the Southeast still holds the highest absolute number (161), its share dropped from 37.6% to 31.3%, indicating a broader geographic distribution of LGBT+ political representation nationwide.

item.title: Lula decreta luto por morte de Glória Menezes e Laura Cardoso: 'Duas de nossas mais importantes atrizes'
item.description: President Lula declared three days of official mourning for the deaths of actresses Glória Menezes and Laura Cardoso, praising their foundational contributions to Brazilian drama over more than seven decades. He hailed them as television pioneers and cultural icons whose legacy continues to inspire new generations of artists in Brazil and abroad.

item.title: Lula decreta luto oficial de 3 dias por Glória Menezes e Laura Cardoso
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three days of official mourning following the deaths of actresses Glória Menezes, aged 91, and Laura Cardoso, aged 98, who passed away on Tuesday (August 18). Both are regarded as icons of Brazilian theater and television, with careers spanning nearly seven decades.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vê caso Lulinha como ‘dolorido’ e aposta em Dark Horse para abafar crise
item.description: Lula's campaign expresses concern over investigations involving Lulinha, calling the situation 'painful', and attempts to divert attention by amplifying allegations against Flávio Bolsonaro, linking the Dark Horse film case to alleged campaign fund diversion. The PT accuses Justice André Mendonça, rapporteur of the inquiries, of applying 'double standards' to favor the opposition, while investigating Lulinha for influence peddling and ties to lobbyists connected to public fund embezzlement schemes.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que tem visão para Brasil diferente da de Lula e cobra ajuste mais ‘suave’ que de Milei
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated he has a different vision for Brazil than Lula and advocated for a milder fiscal adjustment than Milei’s, arguing that a 15% of GDP cut is unnecessary to control public debt. He highlighted that the Propag program, signed by Lula in January 2025, was initiated by Southern and Southeastern governors and helped stabilize São Paulo’s finances, with debt declining relative to revenue and state investments rising to about R$ 30 billion annually.

item.title: Jovens lideram preocupação com impacto de fake news nas eleições, aponta pesquisa
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll shows that 62% of Brazilians view the risk of fake news influencing the 2026 presidential election as high or very high. The finding was released in a subscriber-only article, underscoring growing public concern about disinformation in the electoral process.

item.title: PF abre inquérito sobre fraude na filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police opened an investigation into alleged fraud in the party affiliation change of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, after he appeared in the TSE system as affiliated with the Mission party and unlinked from the PL in under 11 hours, without his consent. The TSE temporarily suspended the Filia party affiliation system while investigating the alteration, which may constitute ideological fraud and false data insertion. A similar attempt was also detected regarding Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s affiliation, though it was not completed.

item.title: Após retomar diálogo com Lula, Alcolumbre dá andamento ao fim da escala 6x1 e à PEC da Segurança
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre signed dispatches to advance the consideration of key government priorities, including the Security PEC and the end of the 6x1 work scale, after months of stall. The move followed renewed dialogue with President Lula, whose relations had been strained since the Senate rejected Jorge Messias' STF nomination. These proposals are seen as vital to Lula's 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Plataformas digitais entregam planos de conformidade ao TSE para eleições
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques stated that all digital platforms have submitted compliance plans for the 2026 elections, detailing measures such as content removal, profile suspensions, and data sharing to safeguard electoral integrity. The platforms also agreed to join a 'situation room' at the TSE during both election rounds to prevent the spread of content aimed at interfering with voter will.

item.title: Roscoe diz que candidatura do PL em Minas Gerais forçou Cleitinho a apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, the PL candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, stated that Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) only openly declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign after the PL launched Roscoe’s candidacy in the state. Roscoe argued that the PL’s decision forced Cleitinho to abandon a neutral stance aimed at attracting Lula voters and align openly with the conservative camp. The launch event, attended by Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighted the strategic value of having both leaders backing the presidential ticket in Minas Gerais, a key state for the national outcome.

item.title: ANPD enfrenta o primeiro grande caso do ECA Digital com Discord
item.description: The ANPD issued a precautionary measure suspending live broadcasts and video sharing on Discord after police identified suspects who allegedly induced a 13-year-old girl to suicide during a stream. The agency found a critical flaw in the platform’s automated risk detection system and deemed its user reporting channels and moderation capacity inadequate. While the ANPD acts administratively, the AGU is expected to respond politically via a TAC requested by President Lula, as First Lady Janja da Silva advocated for a total block of Discord in Brazil.

item.title: Vice de Flávio diz que Marcola acabará preso
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, stated he believes Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola and former chief of staff to Lula, will be arrested due to alleged involvement in a corruption scheme involving lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. Gaspar claimed that revelations about jewelry received by Marcola indicate participation in a corruption ring within the Lula government and that Lula cannot claim ignorance. While Marcola is not yet formally investigated, Fábio Luís da Silva (Lulinha) is already the subject of multiple PF inquiries.

item.title: Caiado diz que, se eleito, gasto do governo ficará limitado de 40% a 50% do crescimento do PIB
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that, if elected, he would limit federal government spending to 40% to 50% of GDP growth, proposing a constitutional amendment to curb rising interest rates. He also addressed the Unecs proposal to exempt the first minimum wage, emphasizing that controlling public spending to lower interest rates comes first. The event included Augusto Cury and Renan Santos, while Flávio Bolsonaro sent representatives and Lula and Zema were absent.

item.title: Arruda defende descentralização de prédios públicos
item.description: José Roberto Arruda (PSD), candidate for Governor of the Federal District, advocated for the decentralization of public buildings to the CADF in Taguatinga, criticating the annual R$1.05 billion spent on renting government offices in Brasília. He highlighted stark social inequality in the capital, contrasting the wealth of the Esplanada with the poverty in Santa Luzia, and pledged to engage in dialogue with the federal government regardless of political affiliation, while also promising to audit and potentially reverse the privatization of Neoenergia through legal action.

item.title: Michelle transmite “abraço hétero” de Bolsonaro a deputado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro conveyed a 'hetero hug' from Jair Bolsonaro to federal deputy Alberto Fraga during the launch of Fraga’s campaign committee in the DF. She also urged unity to elect Flávio Bolsonaro as president and gave a qualified compliment to José Roberto Arruda, despite not supporting him.

item.title: Rogério Marinho: Petrobras é estratégica e será avaliada, mas não há plano de privatizá-la
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid, stated that Petrobras is strategic and will undergo an efficiency assessment, but denied any plan to privatize it. He emphasized that any changes would focus on strengthening the company’s national role, not its divestment.

item.title: Desequilíbrio institucional é culpa do Congresso, corrompido por emendas, diz Alfredo Gaspar
item.description: Federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro on the presidential ticket, accused the National Congress of being 'corrupted' by parliamentary amendments, which he claims create institutional imbalance by favoring particular interests over the public good. He advocates for reforming the amendment system to restore balance among branches and combat legislative corruption.

item.title: Caiado propõe campanha nacional para recuperar ‘cultura vacinal’ e afastar ‘teses malucas’
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) proposed a national campaign to recover Brazil's 'vaccine culture,' aiming to achieve and sustain at least 95% coverage for priority vaccines by 2030. His plan includes active outreach for delayed vaccinations, school-based immunization, integration of vaccination records into electronic health records, and strengthening domestic vaccine production via Butantan and Fiocruz, as part of a broader shift in the SUS toward prevention and digital integration.

item.title: STF torna réu deputado Gilvan da Federal por ofensas a Lula
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) has made Deputy Gilvan da Federal (PL-ES) a defendant in a case of injuria against President Lula, following his April 2025 remarks calling Lula a 'descondenado', 'ex-presidiário', and 'parceiro do crime', while wishing for his death. The Court rejected parliamentary immunity, stating the insults were unrelated to legislative duties and had a personal character, later disseminated on social media to go viral.

item.title: Deltan: Toffoli deu “canetada” no Brasil, mas Reino Unido disse “aqui não”
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol (Novo-PR) criticized Brazil's judicial annulment of the transfer of Lava Jato evidence to the UK, claiming Minister Dias Toffoli issued a "stroke of the pen" that was overturned by the UK's Crown Court, which ruled the evidence could still be used in the confiscation of £7.3 million (R$51 million) from a former Petrobras engineer. The British judge deemed the sharing lawful and in good faith, calling Brazil's reversal "highly unusual" and stating diplomatic consequences should be handled by governments, not courts.

item.title: Flávio ainda não definiu se vai defender proibição das bets, diz vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, has not yet decided whether to support a total ban on online betting platforms ('bets'), according to his running mate Alfredo Gaspar. The campaign team is reviewing current regulations and considering options ranging from new restrictions to a full prohibition, aiming to protect Brazilian families. Gaspar stated he personally favors strict measures, but emphasized this does not yet reflect Flávio's official government plan.

item.title: Aliados veem em caso Lulinha chance de Lula se diferenciar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of President Lula see the Lulinha case as an opportunity to differentiate him from Bolsonaro, advocating that he speak openly about it to demonstrate a commitment to fighting corruption. However, a more conservative faction within the government warns that raising the issue could give ammunition to opponents, who are expected to exploit the case in the coming months.

item.title: Quem é o ex-comandante da FAB que ameaçou prender Bolsonaro se ele tentasse cancelar a eleição
item.description: Lieutenant Brigadier Carlos Baptista Júnior, former commander of the Brazilian Air Force under Bolsonaro, revealed in his book that he warned the ex-president would be arrested if he attempted to cancel the 2022 elections through a state of exception decree. His testimony was crucial in Bolsonaro’s conviction for attempted coup d’état by the STF. Baptista Júnior stated he worked to keep the Armed Forces from institutional rupture during the 2021-2022 political crisis.

item.title: Ex-senador Romero Jucá desiste de candidatura a deputado federal por Roraima: 'Disputa baixa e vil'
item.description: Former Senator Romero Jucá withdrew his candidacy for federal deputy from Roraima, citing personal attacks, backroom deals, and electoral corruption in the political race. He claims he suffered an absurd and illegal judgment, later suspended by the STF, and refuses to participate in what he calls 'low and vile' politics. His withdrawal follows a TRF-1 conviction based on Odebrecht testimony for passive corruption and money laundering, which was provisionally overturned by the STF.

item.title: Lula se queixa da presença de Zema e Renan Santos e decide não ir ao debate Band/Estadão
item.description: President Lula decided not to attend the Band/Estadão debate due to the inclusion of Romeu Zema and Renan Santos, with his allies arguing their participation is not legally required. This marks a shift from 2022, when Lula took part in the same event after negotiating conditions. Flávio Bolsonaro may also be absent, having tied his attendance to Lula’s presence.

item.title: Caiado: gasto do governo ficará limitado de 40% a 50% do crescimento do PIB
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that, if elected, he would limit federal government spending to between 40% and 50% of GDP growth. The proposal aims to control public expenditure expansion relative to economic growth, preventing fiscal excesses.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro respeitará Constituição e fará com que seja exercida em plenitude, diz Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid under the PL party, stated that the candidate will fully respect the Constitution and ensure its complete application. The remark was made in an interview on Tuesday, the 18th, as part of the campaign's effort to convey commitment to the rule of law. Marinho emphasized that Flávio Bolsonaro will operate strictly within legal and institutional boundaries.

item.title: Lula viajará a Natal na quinta-feira em 1º ato político após lançamento de campanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will travel to Natal on Thursday, March 20, for his first political event following the official launch of his re-election campaign. He will attend a gathering alongside the PT’s candidate for Rio Grande do Norte governor, Cadu Xavier, and Governor Fátima Bezerra (PT), reinforcing the party’s state and national alliance.

item.title: Vice de Flávio diz que Lula deve cadeira à "bondade" do STF
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, claimed that Lula owes his presidency to the 'kindness' of the STF, criticizing the Court's monocratic decisions that overturn legislation passed by Congress and alleging that lawmakers fear judicial retaliation. He accused the Judiciary of disrupting the balance of powers and said a Bolsonaro government would seek to restore institutional equilibrium. Gaspar also linked STF actions to legal insecurity harming investment.

item.title: Após ato de Nikolas, sede de campanha do PL é pichada em Juiz de Fora
item.description: The PL campaign headquarters in Juiz de Fora (MG), known as 'Casa da Direita', was vandalized in the early hours of August 18, 2026, with the misspelled word 'facistas' sprayed beside images of Bolsonaro, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Nikolas Ferreira. Earlier, the eyes of the political figures in the murals had also been marked. Candidate Roberta Lopes confirmed the incident was reported to the MG Military Police and that security camera footage is being reviewed to identify those responsible.

item.title: Alcolumbre assina despacho de PECs do fim da escala 6×1 e da Segurança Pública para comissões
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has signed the dispatches to refer the PECs on ending the 6×1 work scale and public security to congressional committees for analysis, though the forwarding has not yet occurred due to the need to appoint rapporteurs and determine which committees will handle the proposals. The Senate’s Mesa is conducting a study to assign the appropriate committees, following procedural rules. Updates on the legislative process will appear in the system in the coming days.

item.title: Ataque a Toffoli em ato de campanha pode virar revés para Lula no TSE
item.description: During a campaign event in São Bernardo do Campo, Lula directly criticized Supreme Court minister Dias Toffoli, recalling a 2019 decision that barred him from attending his brother's funeral. The remark may backfire politically, as Toffoli also serves on the TSE and could influence key rulings in the 2026 election. Analysts warn that Lula's statement might push Toffoli to align with ministers like Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça, strengthening the opposition and shifting the Court's balance.

item.title: Pablo Marçal pede ao TSE correção de declaração de bens e aponta patrimônio de R$ 149,9 milhões
item.description: Pablo Marçal, presidential candidate for PRTB, corrected his asset declaration to the TSE after an error initially reported R$ 7.4 billion due to a mistake in registering a R$ 6.7 million CDB as R$ 6.7 billion. The corrected patrimony is R$ 149.9 million, lower than the R$ 169.5 million declared in his 2024 São Paulo mayoral race. Despite the correction, his candidacy may be denied due to ineligibility from a conviction for irregularities in the 2020 municipal campaign.

item.title: Plano da CNT para candidatos pede 6 X 1, PEC, leilões e financiamento
item.description: The CNT released a transportation plan for 2026 presidential candidates, advocating for the approval of the Infrastructure PEC, private financing through incentivized debentures and multilateral bank partnerships, and the maintenance of the 6X1 work scale, along with railway auctions and budget recomposition for integrated modal infrastructure. The document was presented at the CNT’s 11th Debate Forum, with confirmed participation from Renan Santos (Mission) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), while Lula, Bolsonaro, and Zema have not confirmed attendance.

item.title: Geração Z perde força no mapa eleitoral e acende alerta nos partidos
item.description: Generation Z has lost electoral influence in Brazil, with a 22% decline in voters aged 16 to 24 since 2010 — a loss of 5.5 million young voters. Meanwhile, the overall electorate grew by 17% to 158.8 million, driven by significant growth in voters over 60, whose proportional weight has nearly doubled. This demographic shift is weakening youth representation, concentrated now in the North and Northeast, and forcing parties to reevaluate their strategies as the balance of power in democratic decision-making tilts toward older voters.

item.title: Marinho: Flávio Bolsonaro vai respeitar Constituição e fazer com que seja exercida em plenitude
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, stated that the candidate will respect and fully exercise the Brazilian Constitution if elected, emphasizing the advantage of a parliamentary majority for the PL. He made these remarks at the 'Meeting with Presidential Candidates - Dialogue for Brazil's Future' event in Brasília, where Flávio Bolsonaro was absent due to schedules in Minas Gerais. Other invited candidates, such as Lula and Zema, also did not attend.

item.title: Pesquisa de intenção de voto para presidente: veja últimos levantamentos
item.description: August polls show President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election. In potential runoff scenarios, Lula faces tight races against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with margins varying by polling institute and methodology.

item.title: MPF processa Renan Santos por discurso de ódio contra indígenas do Pará
item.description: The Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office in Pará filed a civil public action against Renan Santos, presidential candidate of the Missão party, and the Liberal Renewal Movement (MBL), for hate speech and discrimination against indigenous peoples of the Lower Tapajós. The complaint alleges that the defendants made statements inciting hatred and stereotyping traditional communities, violating constitutional rights.

item.title: Jornal: Marcola recebeu mensagem de amiga de Lulinha sobre contrato, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police found a WhatsApp message indicating that Marcola, former chief of staff to President Lula, received a contract model for the sale of cannabidiol-based medicines to the Ministry of Health, according to O Globo. The message was allegedly sent by a friend of Lulinha, President Lula's son. The case raises suspicions of undue influence in public procurement processes.

item.title: Malafaia diz que apoia Flávio, mas não organizará atos de campanha
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia said he supports Flávio Bolsonaro’s Senate candidacy but will not organize or coordinate any campaign events, including the PL’s September 7 gathering on Paulista Avenue. He stated his support will be limited to opinion and social media, emphasizing he does not wish to involve himself in party logistics and that political events are the sole responsibility of the parties.

item.title: STF torna Gilvan da Federal réu por desejar a morte de Lula
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) has made federal deputy Gilvan da Federal (PL-ES) a defendant for aggravated insult after he wished for the death of President Lula during a Public Security Committee meeting. The decision was made by the First Chamber, with Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino following the rapporteur Justice Cármen Lúcia's vote.

item.title: Deputado do PL vira réu por injúria contra Lula
item.description: The STF unanimously accepted a PGR indictment against federal deputy Gilvan da Federal (PL-ES) for insulting President Lula, after he called him an 'ex-convict', 'ex-convicted', 'criminal partner', and 'disgrace', and said he hoped for his death. The Court rejected his parliamentary immunity claim, stating the remarks were unrelated to legislative activity. Gilvan is now a defendant and will face criminal prosecution.

item.title: Mineração no Brasil está estagnada e precisa ser “destravada”, diz Vale
item.description: Vale S.A. presented a regulatory agenda to 'unlock' mining in Brazil, arguing the sector is stagnant and losing competitiveness. The document, developed with Accenture and sent to presidential candidates, proposes 15 initiatives covering environmental licensing, business environment, institutional security, and shared value, including standardization of permitting, strengthening agencies like Ibama and ANM, and incentives for mineral transformation.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia é eleita presidente da Primeira Turma do STF
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia was elected president of the First Chamber of the STF in a unanimous and symbolic vote on Tuesday, August 18. She will assume the position on September 30, succeeding Minister Flávio Dino, following the Court’s internal rule of one-year non-renewable presidency rotated by seniority after all members have served.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que vai tentar deixar discussão nacional de lado e falar de São Paulo na campanha
item.description: São Paulo Governor and re-election candidate Tarcísio de Freitas said he will try to keep the state campaign focused on local issues, avoiding national polarization between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. He highlighted his administration’s work in housing, health, urban mobility, education, and women’s protection, stating he has 'much to tell'. Although he supports Flávio Bolsonaro for president, Tarcísio seeks to distance himself from the national ideological battle to strengthen his image in São Paulo, where he leads with 46% voting intention against Haddad’s 30%.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha enviou contrato de canabidiol a ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula?
item.description: WhatsApp messages obtained by the Federal Police show that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger sent a contract model for the sale of cannabidiol-based medicines to the Ministry of Health, without bidding, to former Chief of Staff of President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana (Marcola). Roberta Luchsinger is described as a friend of businessman Fábio, whose full name is not specified in the provided content. The case raises suspicions of undue favoritism in public procurement.

item.title: Lula começa campanha eleitoral com gravações no Lago Sul
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) began recording campaign materials for his re-election bid on Tuesday, August 18, 2026, at his campaign headquarters in Lago Sul, Brasília. He is recording alone, marking the first official content production since the campaign officially started on Sunday, August 16. Free electoral advertising on radio and TV will begin on August 28.
